item: Using technical commands as descriptive prompts (e.g., 'BFS head face swap')
Claiming a style the model cannot perfectly replicate (e.g., calling an AI image a 'photograph')
Using LoRAs at low scales on incompatible pipelines (e.g., zimage with LoRA @ 0.5 for detail)
Ambiguous or conflicting style instructions (e.g., mixing 'photorealistic' and 'painterly')
